steps.eval: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-index]')]; if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error('列表行数不足: ' + rows.length); const row = rows[0]; const addr = row.querySelector('.rp-num.rp-selectable'); const name = row.querySelector('.rp-selectable'); if (!addr) throw new Error('找不到地址单元格'); if (!name) throw new Error('找不到名称单元格'); const pick = (el) => { const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(el); s.addRange(r); return (s.toString() || '').trim(); }; const addrText = pick(addr); if (!addrText) throw new Error('地址文本选中为空'); const nameText = pick(name); if (!nameText) throw new Error('名称文本选中为空'); const sel = window.getSelection(); const range = document.createRange(); range.setStartBefore(name); range.setEndAfter(addr); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(range); const both = (sel.toString() || '').trim(); if (!both) throw new Error('跨名称与地址的区间选择为空'); if (!both.includes(addrText) && both.split(/\s+/).indexOf(addrText) < 0) throw new Error('跨节点选择没有覆盖地址: ' + both.slice(0, 60)); const addrUserSelect = getComputedStyle(addr).userSelect; if (addrUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('地址 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + addrUserSelect); const rowUserSelect = getComputedStyle(row).userSelect; if (rowUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('行 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + rowUserSelect); const btn = row.querySelector('button'); if (!btn) throw new Error('行内找不到操作按钮'); const btnUserSelect = getComputedStyle(btn).userSelect; if (btnUserSelect !== 'none') throw new Error('行内按钮 user-select 应为 none，实际 ' + btnUserSelect); return { addrText, nameText, both: both.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 60), addrUserSelect, rowUserSelect, btnUserSelect }; })()

(() => { const sel = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-index]')].filter((r) => r.className.includes('row-active')).map((r) => Number(r.getAttribute('data-row-index'))); if (JSON.stringify(sel) !== '[1]') throw new Error('选中文本后单击行不再选中，当前 ' + JSON.stringify(sel)); if (document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]')) throw new Error('单击行误打开了抽屉'); return { sel, selection: String(window.getSelection() || '').length }; })()

(() => { const sec = document.getElementById('settings-session'); if (!sec) throw new Error('缺少会话设置分节'); const para = [...sec.querySelectorAll('p')].find((el) => (el.innerText || '').trim().length > 8); if (!para) throw new Error('会话分节没有说明文字'); sec.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(para); s.addRange(r); const picked = (s.toString() || '').trim(); if (!picked) throw new Error('设置说明选中为空'); para.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const paraUserSelect = getComputedStyle(para).userSelect; if (paraUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('设置说明 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + paraUserSelect); const nav = document.querySelector('button[data-settings-nav="true"]'); if (!nav) throw new Error('缺少设置导航按钮'); const navUserSelect = getComputedStyle(nav).userSelect; if (navUserSelect !== 'none') throw new Error('设置导航按钮 user-select 应为 none，实际 ' + navUserSelect); const rowLabel = sec.querySelector('label'); const labelUserSelect = rowLabel ? getComputedStyle(rowLabel).userSelect : 'text'; if (labelUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('设置行标签 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + labelUserSelect); return { picked: picked.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 60), paraUserSelect, navUserSelect, labelUserSelect }; })()
(async () => { const res = await window.api.batchWindow.open({ source: { kind: 'all' }, title: '全部主机' }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('打开批量面板失败: ' + res.error.message); return 'opened'; })()

(() => { const tile = document.querySelector('[data-batch-tile]'); if (!tile) throw new Error('矩阵里没有主机格子'); if (tile.getAttribute('data-batch-selected') !== 'true') throw new Error('单击格子没有进入选中态'); const spans = [...tile.querySelectorAll('span')]; const addr = spans.find((el) => (el.className || '').includes('font-mono')); if (!addr) throw new Error('格子缺少地址文字: ' + tile.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 80)); const statusBox = tile.querySelector('[class*="mt-auto"]'); const status = statusBox ? statusBox.querySelector('span') : null; if (!status || !(status.textContent || '').trim()) throw new Error('格子缺少状态文字'); const pick = (el) => { const s = window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(el); s.addRange(r); return (s.toString() || '').trim(); }; const addrText = pick(addr); if (!addrText) throw new Error('格子地址选中为空'); const statusText = pick(status); if (!statusText) throw new Error('格子状态选中为空'); const sel = window.getSelection(); const span = document.createRange(); span.setStart(addr, 0); span.setEnd(status, status.childNodes.length || 0); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(span); const covered = (sel.toString() || '').trim(); if (!covered.includes(addrText) || !covered.includes(statusText)) throw new Error('格子跨行选择没有同时覆盖地址与状态: ' + covered.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 60)); const addrUserSelect = getComputedStyle(addr).userSelect; if (addrUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('格子地址 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + addrUserSelect); const statusUserSelect = getComputedStyle(status).userSelect; if (statusUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('格子状态 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + statusUserSelect); const tileUserSelect = getComputedStyle(tile).userSelect; if (tileUserSelect !== 'text') throw new Error('格子 user-select 应为 text，实际 ' + tileUserSelect); const action = tile.querySelector('button[data-batch-action]'); if (!action) throw new Error('格子缺少操作按钮'); const actionUserSelect = getComputedStyle(action).userSelect; if (actionUserSelect !== 'none') throw new Error('格子操作按钮 user-select 应为 none，实际 ' + actionUserSelect); const bar = document.querySelector('[data-batch-toolbar="true"]'); if (!bar) throw new Error('缺少矩阵工具栏'); const barBtn = bar.querySelector('button'); const barUserSelect = barBtn ? getComputedStyle(barBtn).userSelect : 'none'; if (barUserSelect !== 'none') throw new Error('工具栏按钮 user-select 应为 none，实际 ' + barUserSelect); const actions = document.querySelector('[data-batch-actions="true"]'); if (!actions || !/已选 1 台/.test(actions.innerText)) throw new Error('动作行没有显示「已选 1 台」: ' + (actions ? actions.innerText.slice(0, 40) : 'null')); return { addrText, statusText, covered: covered.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 40), addrUserSelect, statusUserSelect, tileUserSelect, actionUserSelect, barUserSelect }; })()

(() => { const chosen = document.querySelector('[data-batch-tile][data-batch-selected="true"]'); if (!chosen) throw new Error('选中文本后格子的选中态丢失'); return { selected: 1, selection: String(window.getSelection() || '').length }; })()
